result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one notable visual issue was found related to text truncation in the restaurant listing.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word (cut off at 'Piccol' instead of showing the full name like 'Trattoria Piccolo'), without an ellipsis or any visual indicator that the text is incomplete. This is different from the card being partially off-screen — the text is within a fully visible card area but is simply cut off without proper truncation handling.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a defined width to restaurant name labels so truncated text is clearly indicated with '...' rather than cutting off mid-word.
